Watercolor ( American English ) or watercolour ( Commonwealth English ; see spelling differences ), also aquarelle ( French: [akwaʁɛl] ; from Italian diminutive of Latin aqua 'water'), [ 1 ] is a painting method [ 2 ] in which the paints are made of pigments suspended in a water-based [ 3 ] solution. Watercolor refers to both the medium and the resulting artwork .
